# KappaTilde {#sec-doc}
    

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}    


```julia
KappaTilde()
```
Chart choice for spatial ordinal patterns (SOPs): the statistic $\tilde{\kappa} = \tilde{p}_1 - \tilde{p}_2$, the difference of the first and second type frequencies of the refined SOP classification.
 


:::
